# GitHub Repository Configuration

## Purpose

This folder stores repository-level contribution and issue handling assets for the IE Platform documentation repository.

## Contents

- Issue templates
- Pull request templates
- Community workflow guidance

## Naming Convention

Use repository templates with stable names and consistent metadata.

## Ownership

The Documentation Guild manages these workflow assets.

## Review Process

Review these files when contribution workflow or issue handling changes.
